text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Numerous strange phenomena assailed Manhattan Cafe.
Even so, through devoted care, she managed to achieve an acceptable result.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Her weight... still fluctuates drastically as usual...
However, her race results have become reasonably consistent.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"This is all thanks to you, Trainer...
Though I am still far from my goal."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I try to imagine the words she swallowed back,
but I have no idea what she is thinking.
choice_data_list: What should we do for our next goal?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Given her condition, it may be difficult to compete
in the spring Classic races.
Even so, I do not wish to limit her possibilities myself."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, I decided to ask Manhattan Cafe for her thoughts.
That should surely reveal what she's feeling.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to... admit it...
I just don't want to...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, no matter what... my 'friend'
keeps pointing to that person. That's why――"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Head to the Yayoi Sho, where Tachyon-san is running.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's not as if I... wish for this either.
It's just that my "friend" says so.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Keep running," she said.
"If you don't run..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that... I don't know.
She just... said that, and nothing more...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's steeled her resolve.
—At least from a Trainer's perspective...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If she delivers results in the Yayoi Sho,
it will lead directly to a GⅠ race. If so—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! Tachyon-san is a handful...
But... she is an incredible Umamusume..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: One of the absolute top elites... But the current me might just stand a chance... I'll take them on in the Yayoi Sho.
